scope: The eight static Android toolbar glyph definitions only. Parent button surfaces, focus/toggle states, and native spatial navigation retain separate coverage records.

checks.details: All eight Figma entries are static 24x24 components with no exposed properties or variants. Exact SVGs retained; official Android Svg2Vector conversion completed without warnings. All SVG and native resource root dimensions and hashes are checked by coverage:check.
Android library, phone sample, XR library, XR sample and instrumentation APK compiled with the pinned toolchain.
All eight resources load and render. Named native actions have at least 48dp targets and update caller-owned state. The full six-test class passed after the sample text-contrast correction.

Reviewed all eight rendered silhouettes against their individual Figma screenshots: outlined/filled stars, share, comment, download, edit, more-vertical and image. Native vector resources retain the source geometry. XR world capture is used because 2D host-window PixelCopy returned blank frames.

Glyph rendering is fixed at24dp and independent of font size and layout direction. Color inherits LocalContentColor (or explicit caller tint) for native parent states; a null description is decorative. Destination labels, focus, toggles and screen-reader announcements belong to the consuming native control. These entries have no intrinsic interaction or state variants.
